wish.text: Only the owner can delete a project.

grant.narration: The paw twitches, then lies still. Your wish is granted — in the only shape it could remember.

curses.story: The wish is followed to the letter at every scale, including the scales you never named.
curses.loophole: The wish does not bound the scale at which it must hold.
